chunks: When He revealed to His votary what He revealed.

key_terms.عَبْدِهِ: His servant (referring to the Prophet Muhammad SAWW)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'He revealed to His servant what He revealed' refer to in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this verse is pivotal for establishing the infallibility (Ismah) of the Prophet, as the root 'waḥā' implies a swift, clear revelation free from error, countering the Quraysh's accusations of madness. It specifically anchors the Mi'raj narrative, highlighting the unique spiritual station where the Prophet witnessed divine realities directly, a theme further elaborated in the subsequent verses regarding the six major signs.
